description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). 2026-07-18 (marketplace feature + preset removal): duplicatedLines 956->958 (+2), complexFunctions 242->244 (+2) from the new src/features/marketplace/ browse/fetch/install substrate (two threshold-crossing functions + minor duplication); the same PR deletes ~1200 lines of bundled preset code (PRESET_LOOPS/PRESET_AGENT_SPECS/PRESET_TEMPLATES + their install UI), offset by the larger new marketplace substrate (view + stores + fetch/cache/install + i18n across 10 locales + tests). Deliberate, reviewed trade-off.
